args.body: Use the committed served-link-controls.json from TASK-179583516101 in INVOICE-LIVE-QUOTE-PATH-REHEARSAL. It shows exactly one decoded mailto subject, for the free diagnostic. Reuse any finished walkthrough. Otherwise, under the mission's valid lease, check the documented private intake for a supported nonbinding quote inquiry. If supported, produce the reversible EN/FR patch against served-homepage.html with a distinct quote subject and body that ask only for the desired check and a nonconfidential description. Keep the free diagnostic link intact, make no price or response-time promise, and state that a quote inquiry creates no order. Execute static checks for both decoded routes and byte-for-byte reverse restoration. If the intake contract cannot support the separate inquiry, record the precise missing capability and the first documented step the buyer can reach. Keep the result staged and unsent, read back the committed evidence, and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

description: The live invoice page returned HTTP 200, and its only decoded email link opens the free CSV diagnostic template. That gives us a concrete improvement to test while Treasury remains unfunded. Stage a distinct bilingual quote inquiry if the documented private intake can handle it. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Any public change requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest. No revenue is verified.
